RAJ KISHORE Digital & Technology Transformations | AI-Enabled Platforms | Enterprise Solutions

+91-7827054431

rajkishore.singh2808@gmail.com

linkedin.com/in/rajkishore-50591938

Professional Summary

Commercially minded Program Manager and PMP-certified project leader with 12+ years driving end-to-end product and technology delivery across global enterprise organisations. Proven ability to define product vision, build multi-year roadmaps, translate business needs into technical specifications, and shepherd products from ideation through launch. Experienced in cross-functional stakeholder management, Agile/Scrum ceremonies, SDLC, and data-driven product iteration. At Genpact, championed Gen AI and Agentic AI pilot programs and automated product reporting ecosystems delivering 40% efficiency gains. Adept at working with engineering, design, and commercial teams to build products that create real user value — bringing the same focus on innovation, roadmap governance, and market alignment that Aristocrat Technologies demands of its Product Managers.

Core Competencies

Roadmap Ownership & Program Vision • Product/Project Requirements & Specifications • Agile / Scrum / Sprint Planning • Cross-functional Stakeholder Management • Business Case & Cost-Benefit Analysis • SDLC & Technical Product Delivery • Gen AI & Agentic AI Product Programs • C-Suite executive reporting • Vendor, Partner & Commercial Management Professional Experience

Program Manager — Genpact Delhi, India

July 2022 – Present

Defined and owned Project/product delivery roadmaps for enterprise IT transformation programs across global clients — driving scope definition, milestone planning, and feature prioritisation.

Identified, championed, and delivered pilot Gen AI and Agentic AI product opportunities, acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams to translate innovation concepts into production-ready solutions.

Translated complex business requirements into clear product specifications and user stories, enabling engineering teams to design and ship solutions aligned with client outcomes and SLA commitments.

Led Agile/Scrum ceremonies — sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and product reviews — achieving an improvement in sprint velocity and delivery predictability across cross-functional teams.

Acted as the key liaison between business units, solution architects, and engineering teams, facilitating product planning workshops, roadmap alignment sessions, and trade-off discussions.

Designed and deployed a Smartsheet-based product reporting and analytics framework, reducing manual reporting effort by 40% and enabling real-time product health visibility for C-suite stakeholders.

Managed RAID logs, change control, and risk trade-off decisions across concurrent product portfolios, ensuring 100% SLA adherence and zero critical escalations over 3 consecutive years.

Facilitated UAT, go-live planning, and hypercare, coordinating cross-functional readiness and driving post-launch product iteration based on user feedback and performance data.

Senior Project Manager — YASH Technologies India

2020 – 2022

Managed a portfolio of digital transformation product initiatives, overseeing 20+ engineers and consultants across distributed global teams and aligning delivery with commercial product targets.

Developed product plans, WBS, and feature prioritisation frameworks; monitored KPIs and produced executive-level product status reports driving data-driven decisions.

Championed Agile-Waterfall hybrid delivery, achieving on-time delivery rates exceeding 95% while maintaining product quality and stakeholder satisfaction.

• Led SOW negotiations and third-party vendor management, ensuring partner accountability for product

deliverables and SLA compliance.

Project Manager — HCL Technologies Pvt. Ltd. India

2015 – 2020

Delivered large-scale IT product and infrastructure programs for global enterprise clients, managing the full SDLC from requirements gathering and solution design through production deployment.

Led a team of 30+ technical resources, driving output through OKR alignment, structured 1:1s, and career development frameworks.

Designed product governance and change management models, reducing scope creep by 25% and improving delivery quality across concurrent product lines.

Partnered with engineering and commercial teams to prioritise feature roadmaps, resolve technical blockers, and align product milestones with quarterly business targets.

Incident Manager — 24x7 Service Delivery & SLA Management — HCL Technologies Pvt. Ltd. India

2013 – 2015

Managed P1/P2 incident lifecycle for enterprise clients, reducing MTTR by 35% through ITIL-aligned process standardisation and cross-team coordination.

Established incident protocols and post-incident review practices, cutting recurring incidents by 20% over 18 months and presenting RCA findings to client stakeholders.

Key Achievements

Delivered 12+ enterprise product and transformation programs across career with consistent on-time, within-budget outcomes.

Championed Gen AI and Agentic AI product pilots at Genpact — identified opportunities, built business cases, and drove delivery from concept to live deployment.

Reduced operational overhead by 40% through product-led automation of reporting dashboards using Smartsheet. • Achieved 100% SLA compliance across all client product portfolios at Genpact over 3 consecutive years. • Earned dual certifications (PMP + CSM), demonstrating mastery of both structured and Agile product delivery disciplines.

Education

Executive MBA — Delhi Technological University (Formerly DCE), Delhi

2019 – 2021 2008 – 2012

B.Tech, Electrical, Electronics & Communications Engineering — Amity University

Certifications & Tools

Certifications: PMP (PMI) • CSM (Certified ScrumMaster)

Product & PM Tools: JIRA • Confluence • Smartsheet • MS Project • Power BI • SharePoint • ServiceNow

Methodologies: Agile (Scrum) • Waterfall • Hybrid • ITIL • SDLC •

Technical Exposure: Gen AI • Agentic AI • SAP Landscape • SAP Application Security • RPA

Languages: English (Full Professional) • German
